firstContext: You settle into the hall floor. Sleep takes you.
Fever dreams shake you — wings, black water, a sky full of eyes. (-2 HP)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (17/9/8), with 7 wave-4 fought, 15 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 6 · Craft 5 · Talk 23 · Explore 39 → 24 · capped)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Paula Rosas ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

◈ THE PANTHEON — Paula Rosas and Mateo Alvarez ascended together, and gods, it turns out, have politics. They argue about you the way the living argue about weather. Mostly, they agree: the village comes first. Mostly.
